title: Grateful Dead Live at University of Virginia on 1982-09-14
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) ->Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC/24
source: AKG 414 -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Maxell XLII-S/TDK MA-R)

ai_review.summary: Fair audience recording captures the vibe of a solid 1982 show with standout Supplication and Birdsong, though boomy venue sound detracts.
ai_review.review: The taping faithfully reproduces the hall’s ambience and crowd energy, delivering a memorable 9‑minute "Supplication" and an adventurous "Birdsong," while the second set is praised as one of ’82’s better mixes. The audio is marred by a noticeable boom from the venue, making a soundboard source preferable for pure clarity. Overall the performance is good but not spectacular, leading to mixed feelings about the show.

ai_rating.rationale: Only two reviews with divergent opinions; one praises the music and ambience, the other calls the show merely "good enough" and notes recording boom.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Captures crowd mood and hall acoustics well, but suffers from a distracting venue boom that reduces clarity; overall decent but not as clean as a board recording.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set mixes varied material and is regarded among the top shows of ’82, though one reviewer felt the overall concert was not great.
